title: Reference Carrier Frequencies, Preemphasis Characteristic and Audio and Control Signals for 3/4-in Type E Helical-Scan Video Tape Cassette Recording
scope: This practice specifies the reference frequencies for deviation of the frequency modulated carrier and associated video preemphasis characteristic for 3/4-in type E helical-scan video tape cassette recording of 525-line monochrome and NTSC color television signals at a tape speed of 95.3 mm/s (3.752 in/s). In addition, the characteristics of the audio and control signals are specified.

definitions.definition: shall be adjusted to produce maximum playback
